subject: Request: Multi-year rate stability + renewal protection - Orbit Toys
messages:
From: Aaron Lewis <aaron.lewis@orbittoys.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Multi-year pricing request + price lock / renewal protection

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the demo earlier this week — the team at Orbit is excited about Redwood's latency/cost profile for our customer-facing agents. We have an internal procurement timeline tied to a Q1 roll-out and leadership has asked whether Redwood can support a multi-year commercial commitment with two specific protections:

- A price lock for 24 months from signature (no per-token price increases)
- A renewal protection clause that caps the first renewal uplift (if any) to a fixed percent (leadership mentioned 10% as an upper bound) assuming commitment levels are maintained or increased

Can you confirm if Redwood can commit to language like that? We are prepared to sign for a 36-month commitment total with an annualized usage commitment and prefer predictable unit economics. If this is doable, we also need a draft statement of work / MA redline we can start procurement with.

Happy to hop on a call if that's easier.

Thanks,
Aaron
Aaron Lewis
Head of Procurement, Orbit Toys
aaron.lewis@orbittoys.com
(415) 555-0182

[Attachment: initial_request_orbit.pdf (pdf)]

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Aaron Lewis <aaron.lewis@orbittoys.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Multi-year pricing request + price lock / renewal protection

Aaron —

Appreciate the clear ask and the fast timeline. We can support a multi-year structure but a couple of internal approvals are required for the specific protections you listed. High level proposal from my side:

- 24-month guaranteed price lock on per-token rates from signature
- Uplift cap on renewal pricing: maximum of 8% at the first renewal (we can add a floor-trigger mechanic that ties to usage)
- Requirement: minimum annual committed spend threshold (we typically require an ARR minimum for multi-year locked pricing; I'll include the number in the formal approval)

I've looped in Markus (Sales Lead) for commercial approval and David (Legal) for contract language.

I'll push a redline of the master agreement with suggested wording and a short pricing summary. Can you confirm the target signature date? That will help with our revenue recognition/calendar approval.

Thanks — Priya
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.ai
[Attachment: ORBIT-MA-draft-v3_redline.pdf (pdf)]

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 08:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Multi-year pricing request + price lock / renewal protection

Priya / David —

I reviewed Priya's summary. Approve the following commercial guardrails for Orbit:

- Approve 24-month price lock on the proposed per-token rates, conditional on Orbit committing to a minimum ARR of $1.2M across the initial 24 months.
- Approve a renewal uplift cap of 7% for the first renewal period (slightly tighter than Priya's 8% ask).
- Any uplift beyond the cap must be justified by material changes in model pricing/hardware cost and signed off by VP Sales.

If Orbit agrees to the minimum ARR and signs within 2 weeks, we can offer a one-time onboarding credit equal to 5% of first-year committed spend.

Please confirm the final numbers in the pricing spreadsheet and get a signed MA.

—Markus
Markus Klein
Director, Sales | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 10:44:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Multi-year pricing request + price lock / renewal protection

All —

I've drafted a redline with language to capture the price lock and renewal protection. Key legal notes:

- Price lock clause: "Redwood shall not increase the per-unit fees for the locked services during the Twenty-Four (24) month Price Lock Period following the Effective Date."
- Renewal protection: "At the first renewal term, any increase to per-unit fees shall not exceed Seven Percent (7%) unless Customer reduces committed usage by more than 25% versus the prior term; in such event standard pricing may apply."
- Inclusion of minimum ARR and onboarding credit as commercial terms (we'll add an appendix for billing schedule)
- Need to ensure indemnity, data handling, and audit log terms align with our Private deployment options if Orbit requests them later.

I've attached the redline and a short comment summary. If Markus is comfortable, I can push this version to DocuSign with the commercial terms inserted.

Best,
David Kim
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
david.kim@redwood.ai
[Attachment: ORBIT-MA-draft-v3_redline.pdf (redline pdf)]

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Aaron Lewis <aaron.lewis@orbittoys.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:17:00 -0800
Subject: Final terms & DocuSign link — Orbit Toys multi-year commitment (ORBIT-2026-1120)

Aaron —

Thanks for the patience. Per our internal approvals, Redwood can offer the following negotiated terms for ORBIT-2026-1120:

Summary of negotiated commercial terms:
- Term: 36 months total; initial guaranteed Price Lock Period: 24 months from Effective Date
- Price Lock: no increase to agreed per-token rates during 24-month Price Lock Period
- Renewal protection: first renewal increase capped at 7% provided Orbit meets or exceeds committed usage; otherwise standard pricing may apply
- Minimum ARR requirement for Price Lock: $1.2M (applies to the first 24 months)
- Onboarding credit: 5% credit applied to first-year invoices if signed within 14 days of this email

Attached: pricing-summary-orbit-20261123.xlsx (spreadsheet) and the redlined MA. I have created a DocuSign envelope for signature: https://www.docusign.com/mock/ds-orbit-20261123 (link below).

Next steps:
1) Review and confirm acceptance of the summary above
2) Sign MA via DocuSign
3) Once signed, we'll schedule the onboarding kickoff and share the technical contact list

Let me know if you'd like a quick call to walk through the renewal protection language.

Cheers,
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0127

Attachments:
- pricing-summary-orbit-20261123.xlsx (excel)
- ORBIT-MA-draft-v3_redline.pdf (pdf)
